contradictions.contradiction: The startup migration fenced only version 8 dedicated leases while the real version 7 background runner owns a separate PID lock and may survive an unchecked LaunchAgent bootout.
contradictions.root_cause: Legacy process authority and new database authority had no shared quiescence proof, so migration could delete the shared resume state while a version 7 runner still held Desktop-input authority.
contradictions.resolution: Require Legacy Runner Quiescence Gate v1 before opening the migration transaction: checked fixed-label bootout and unloaded proof, then absent/dead legacy lock owner and exact stale-lock quarantine with parent fsync; live or unknown identity leaves data untouched and prevents version 8 runner bootstrap.

contradictions.contradiction: A verified health snapshot did not bind later resume mutations, while each real request can independently resolve a different Core and a live Core could overwrite another live manifest.
contradictions.root_cause: Runtime compatibility was treated as a UI enablement check rather than a request-scoped mutation authority carried through transport and revalidated before parsing.
contradictions.resolution: Require Runtime Mutation Binding v1 on every dedicated mutation, with exact expected snapshot retention, transport-side fresh manifest comparison, Core pre-parser manifest and immutable-runtime parity, zero mutation on drift, and live manifest-owner overwrite refusal.

contradictions.contradiction: Runner quiescence alone did not exclude a still-live version 7 Core before the real openDb migration path.
contradictions.root_cause: Live manifest-owner detection remained after database open and was treated as a warning instead of pre-open authority.
contradictions.resolution: Require Legacy Core Owner Exclusion v1 before every openDb, aborting on live or unknown identity and recovering only an exact stale owner.

contradictions.contradiction: The contract required migration before version 8 runner bootstrap but did not name the ordering owner or acknowledgement, while Tauri currently bootstraps first.
contradictions.root_cause: A desired order was documented without assigning the cross-process handshake to the actual packaged startup orchestrator.
contradictions.resolution: Make Tauri the sole packaged orchestrator and require exact new Core PID manifest-health parity plus schema-8 ready acknowledgement before idempotent runner bootstrap.

contradictions.contradiction: The structurally valid Contract Matrix omitted the newly load-bearing quiescence and mutation-binding gates.
contradictions.root_cause: Matrix regeneration reused the prior invariant list and only refreshed artifact hashes.
contradictions.resolution: Add explicit invariant rows for legacy Core exclusion, legacy runner quiescence, Tauri upgrade ordering, runtime mutation binding and the expected-runtime header, each with complete occurrences and non-empty writer/readers.

contradictions.contradiction: The expected-runtime mutation header was required by transport but absent from the browser preflight authority.
contradictions.root_cause: The request-bound header was added without tracing the existing exact CORS header allowlist.
contradictions.resolution: Permit exactly content-type plus x-devdiary-expected-core-target for trusted origins and reject extra headers or untrusted origins before body parsing.
